title: Rightsizing / Overview
description: Estimated savings, capacity requested vs used vs recommended, and workload modes / risk flags.

list.name: datasource
list.label: Data source
list.description: Prometheus-compatible data source with the hub's VictoriaMetrics (or Prometheus).

panels.title: Net savings / month
panels.description: Estimated USD per month if every recommendation were applied: savings from decreases minus the cost of increases (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd, summed over containers and resources). Estimated, not realized.

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: From decreases
panels.description: Sum of positive savings only: what over-provisioned containers would free up per month.

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) > 0)

panels.title: Cost of increases
panels.description: Sum of negative savings: what under-provisioned containers (throttled, OOM-killed, …) would cost per month once raised. Shown as a negative amount.

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}) < 0)

panels.title: Node cost / month
panels.description: Current price of all priced nodes in the selected clusters × 730 h (kerf_node_hourly_cost_usd from the pricing service). Not filtered by namespace.

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, node) (kerf_node_hourly_cost_usd{cluster=~"$cluster"})) * 730

panels.title: Share of node cost
panels.description: Net monthly savings as a share of the monthly node cost of the selected clusters. Indicative: the namespace filter narrows the savings but not the node cost.

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})) / (sum(max by (cluster, node) (kerf_node_hourly_cost_usd{cluster=~"$cluster"})) * 730)

panels.title: Savings by cluster
panels.description: Net estimated monthly savings per cluster. Click through to the ranked opportunities.

targets.expr: sort_desc(sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})))

panels.title: Top namespaces by savings
panels.description: The 15 namespaces with the highest net estimated monthly savings across the selected clusters.

targets.expr: sort_desc(topk(15, sum by (cluster, namespace) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}))))

panels.title: Savings by resource
panels.description: Net estimated monthly savings split into CPU and memory.

targets.expr: sum by (resource) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: Net savings over time
panels.description: History of the net estimated monthly savings per cluster, as recomputed by every recommender run. A drop means recommendations were applied or usage grew.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container, resource) (kerf_recommendation_monthly_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: Realized savings (since the first change)
panels.description: What the changes Kerf applied actually saved: requests released by applied changes × replicas that ran × node rates of the time, from the first change on (kerf_hub_realized_savings_usd, computed hourly by the hub). Realized, not estimated: never add it to the estimated panels above. Method: docs/realized-savings.md.

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, resource) (kerf_hub_realized_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: CPU released now
panels.description: CPU requests released by applied changes in the last computed hour, × replicas.

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, resource) (kerf_hub_realized_released_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu"}))

panels.title: Memory released now
panels.description: Memory requests released by applied changes in the last computed hour, × replicas.

targets.expr: sum(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, resource) (kerf_hub_realized_released_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"}))

panels.title: Realized savings over time
panels.description: Cumulative realized savings per cluster (USD since the first applied change). The slope is the saving per hour; a flat line means nothing is released (rolled back, or handed back to Git).

targets.expr: sum by (cluster) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, resource) (kerf_hub_realized_savings_usd{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: Capacity: requested vs used vs recommended
CPU: requested vs used vs recommended
panels.description: Requested = requests of running containers (kube-state-metrics). Used = cAdvisor CPU usage rate. Recommended = recommended request × average replicas per workload (hub). The gap between Requested and Recommended is the rightsizing opportunity.

targets.expr:
sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu"})
  and on (cluster, namespace, pod, container)
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})
)
sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (kerf_recommendation_cpu_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", source="recommended"})
  * on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_average_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)

panels.title: Memory: requested vs used vs recommended
panels.description: Requested = requests of running containers (kube-state-metrics). Used = cAdvisor working set. Recommended = recommended request × average replicas per workload (hub). The gap between Requested and Recommended is the rightsizing opportunity.

targets.expr:
sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"})
  and on (cluster, namespace, pod, container)
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})
)
sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}))

sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (kerf_recommendation_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", source="recommended"})
  * on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_average_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)

panels.title: CPU used / requested
panels.description: Share of the requested CPU that running containers actually use right now. Low = over-provisioned.

targets.expr:
(sum(rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}[$__rate_interval]))) / (sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu"})
  and on (cluster, namespace, pod, container)
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})
))

panels.title: CPU change if applied
panels.description: Recommended vs current CPU requests of the workloads the hub covers (both × average replicas). Negative = the fleet needs fewer cores.

targets.expr:
(sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (kerf_recommendation_cpu_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", source="recommended"})
  * on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_average_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)) / (sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (kerf_recommendation_cpu_cores{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", source="current"})
  * on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_average_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)) - 1

panels.title: Memory used / requested
panels.description: Share of the requested memory that running containers use right now (working set).

targets.expr:
(sum(max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"}))) / (sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (kube_pod_container_resource_requests{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory"})
  and on (cluster, namespace, pod, container)
  max by (cluster, namespace, pod, container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", container!="", container!="POD"})
))

panels.title: Memory change if applied
panels.description: Recommended vs current memory requests of the workloads the hub covers (both × average replicas).

targets.expr:
(sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (kerf_recommendation_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", source="recommended"})
  * on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_average_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)) / (sum (
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, container) (kerf_recommendation_memory_bytes{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", type="request", source="current"})
  * on (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) group_left ()
  max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_average_replicas{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})
)) - 1

panels.title: Workloads
panels.description: Workloads known to the hub (every workload reported by an agent or seen in metrics).

targets.expr: count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu"}) == 1)

panels.title: Recommended
panels.description: Workloads that have a current recommendation (needs usage data).

targets.expr: count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_confidence{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: Confidence (avg)
panels.description: Mean recommendation confidence (0–1). Below 0.5 the hub flags low-confidence; the agent's default guardrail needs 0.7 to apply.

targets.expr: avg(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_confidence{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: Coverage (avg)
panels.description: Mean fraction of the recommendation window that has usage samples.

targets.expr: avg(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_data_coverage_ratio{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"}))

panels.title: Flagged
panels.description: Workloads with at least one risk flag (throttled, oom-killed, restarting, hpa-coupled, sidecar, short-lived, low-confidence).

targets.expr: count(count by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload, flag) (kerf_recommendation_risk_flag{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace"})))

panels.title: In auto-patch
panels.description: Workloads with auto-patch as the effective mode for CPU or memory.

targets.expr: count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", mode="auto-patch"}) == 1)

panels.title: Workloads per mode
panels.description: Effective mode per resource (D-005: global default audit < cluster default < policy < annotation).

targets.expr:
label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu", mode="off"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "mode", "off", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu", mode="audit"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "mode", "audit", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="cpu", mode="auto-patch"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "mode", "auto-patch", "", "")

label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory", mode="off"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "mode", "off", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory", mode="audit"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "mode", "audit", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_mode{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", resource="memory", mode="auto-patch"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "mode", "auto-patch", "", "")

panels.title: Workloads per risk flag
panels.description: How many workloads carry each risk flag. throttled / oom-killed: never decreased; hpa-coupled: audit only (D-011); low-confidence: confidence < 0.5.

targets.expr:
label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_risk_flag{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", flag="throttled"}))) or vector(0), "flag", "throttled", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_risk_flag{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", flag="oom-killed"}))) or vector(0), "flag", "oom-killed", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_risk_flag{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", flag="restarting"}))) or vector(0), "flag", "restarting", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_risk_flag{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", flag="hpa-coupled"}))) or vector(0), "flag", "hpa-coupled", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_risk_flag{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", flag="sidecar"}))) or vector(0), "flag", "sidecar", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_risk_flag{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", flag="short-lived"}))) or vector(0), "flag", "short-lived", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_recommendation_risk_flag{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", flag="low-confidence"}))) or vector(0), "flag", "low-confidence", "", "")

panels.title: Workloads per phase
panels.description: Current RightsizingRecommendation phase reported by the agents. Pending = nothing applied yet.

targets.expr:
label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Pending"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "phase", "Pending", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Applying"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "phase", "Applying", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Applied"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "phase", "Applied", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Blocked"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "phase", "Blocked", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", phase="RolledBack"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "phase", "RolledBack", "", "")
 or label_replace((count(max by (cluster, namespace, workload_kind, workload) (kerf_workload_phase{cluster=~"$cluster", namespace=~"$namespace", phase="Released"}) == 1)) or vector(0), "phase", "Released", "", "")

panels.title: Last recommender run
panels.description: Time since the recommender last succeeded for each cluster. Production runs every 24 h (orange after 26 h, red after 48 h); the dev environment runs every 5 min.

targets.expr: time() - max by (cluster) (kerf_recommender_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"$cluster"})

panels.title: Pricing source
panels.description: Whether savings for each cluster use live node prices from the pricing service or the hub's default rates (kerf_recommender_pricing_fallback = 1).

targets.expr: max by (cluster) (kerf_recommender_pricing_fallback{cluster=~"$cluster"})
